routers.name: Agent Router
routers.description: $100 to $200 on GitHub signup, depending on which referral link you arrive through. Coding agents only: requests must originate from Claude Code, Codex, Cline or similar, and a plain chat client is refused.

declared.note: Amount depends on the referral link used.

duty: Coding agents only — chat clients refused
routers.setup: Sign up with GitHub through the board link — the grant depends on the referral link you arrive through. After signup, generate an API key in the dashboard and copy the API base URL shown there. Requests must come from a coding agent: in Claude Code set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN to the gateway values, or configure Codex / Cline with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint using the same key. Plain chat clients are refused.

routers.name: Bai
routers.description: 300,000 tokens on signup through a referral link. The free plan's model list is short, but the models on it are current.

declared.note: Granted as tokens, not as a dollar balance.

duty: Referral link required for the full grant
Free plan limits the model list
routers.setup: Sign in with Google through the board link; the 300,000-token grant lands in your account (a plain signup without the referral link grants less). Use the chat interface directly, or generate an API key in your account page for API clients. The free plan model list is short but current.

routers.name: Xiaomi Mimo
routers.description: $3 on register, plus $3 per referral up to thirty people. Small, but it is the only offer on this board served from a first-party vendor domain rather than a reseller.

declared.note: Referrals can add $3 each, up to thirty.

routers.setup: Register with an email on the first-party platform; the  grant applies at signup and each referral adds  (up to thirty people). Use the MiMo models in the web chat or via the platform API with a dashboard key.

routers.name: GoRouter
routers.description: $70 on signup, but only for GitHub accounts created before 2026. Anthropic models only. A $40 referral bonus is advertised on top of the signup grant.
routers.setup: Sign up with GitHub — the account must have been created before 2026. Anthropic models only: in Claude Code set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN from your dashboard, or use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with other clients. A  per-referral bonus is advertised on top of the signup grant.

routers.name: Bluesminds
routers.description: $100 welcome credit on GitHub signup, scaling upward with the age of the account. Routes 160-plus models through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint; some of them are intermittently unavailable.

declared.note: Base grant; scales upward with GitHub account age.

routers.setup: Sign up with GitHub; the base  grant scales upward with account age. Generate an API key and use the single OpenAI-compatible endpoint for all 160+ models — ids like gpt-5.6-sol or deepseek-v4-pro work in Claude Code (custom provider), Codex, Cline, or any OpenAI-compatible client. Some routed models are intermittently unavailable.

routers.name: JustDoWork
routers.description: $100 on signup with a $20 daily check-in on top. Anthropic models only. Neither the signup amount nor the daily top-up could be confirmed away from affiliate sources.

declared.note: A further $20 per day is advertised for checking in.

routers.setup: Sign up with GitHub for the  grant; a  daily check-in is advertised on top. Anthropic models only — set the Anthropic-compatible base URL and token from the dashboard in Claude Code (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN), or use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint elsewhere. Neither figure could be confirmed away from affiliate sources.

routers.name: TaBiAi
routers.description: on GitHub signup, Anthropic models only. Earlier reports of the amount conflicted; the figure is now marked verified on the board.
routers.setup: Sign up with GitHub;  is the reported grant, but reports conflict — treat the amount as disputed. Anthropic models only: same pattern as other Anthropic gateways — dashboard key, then ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN in Claude Code or the OpenAI-compatible endpoint in other clients.

routers.name: SeeK AI
routers.description: A $200 signup credit is advertised against a broad chat-model list. Neither the amount nor the catalogue could be confirmed against any source that was not itself an affiliate link.

declared.note: Advertised figure; no independent confirmation found.

routers.setup: Sign up with an email;  is advertised but was never confirmed outside affiliate links. Chat models only (no coding-agent requirement). Generate a key in the dashboard and use the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the model ids on the card. No one has verified it — rank your expectations accordingly.

routers.name: Hcnsec
routers.description: A large grant on register, reported as thousands of credits, with no unit ever stated. Chinese models only. The amount could not be established in any form, so no grade is implied.

declared.note: Reported as thousands of credits with no unit stated anywhere.

duty: Amount never stated in any unit
routers.setup: Sign up with an email; the grant is reported as thousands of credits with no unit ever stated. Chinese models only (DeepSeek, kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, glm, step). Expect a dashboard key and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

routers.name: KKToken
routers.description: $100 on signup, confirmed on the board. The catalogue, pricing and remaining terms sit behind the login wall — review them after creating the account.
duty: Catalogue and amount only visible after signup
routers.setup: Sign up with an email, but know this first: the catalogue, pricing, and signup grant are only visible after you create the account. If the terms matter before you commit, this one cannot help you decide in advance.
